text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Multiple containers on gpu-node-12 restarted (OOM) across 3 jobs in the last 7m. Symptoms: CUDA driver warnings, cgroup OOM, repeated container restarts. See /incidents/1753210000
ara: I'm taking this. seeing 2x OOMs on gpu-node-12 around 17:34 UTC. Crash logs show "CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS" then cgroup kill. Also paged-attention allocator shows steady resident growth.
tim: thanks. can you paste the crash snippet? i'm watching metrics.
ara: logs:
```
2025-10-11T17:34:12Z runtime: attention_paged_alloc: alloc failed size=5242880 slab=kv_cache slot=1248
2025-10-11T17:34:12Z runtime: cuda: cuLaunch failed: CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS
2025-10-11T17:34:12Z kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 22113 (redwood-runtime)
```
leila: interesting — allocator failure then gpu illegal addr. could be memory corruption from fragmented KV pages + page churn. we've seen slow 'bleed' before where fragmentation prevents eviction making resident climb until OOM.
samantha: any customer impact observed? Pager alerted because restarts triggered health checks.
ara: traf: small but steady 503 spikes for a subset of requests hitting that node's shard. ~0.5% of requests in region-eu over last 10m. Support: no customer tickets yet.
tim: can we cordon/drain the node? If it's flappy, better to evacuate serving jobs.
ara: initiating cordon + drain now. kubectl drain gpu-node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Node cordoned; evicting pods (inflight connections will be retried by load balancer)
samantha: good. while drain runs, any quick mitigations to reduce bleed? maybe force a compaction pass or increase eviction aggressiveness for KV.
leila: we have an internal runtime flag KV_EVICT_IMPULSE or similar. can toggle at process level via SIGHUP to set aggressive eviction, but it requires runtime to honor it. alternative: disable paged-attention for new containers on that node (launch non-paged variant) — but that needs image with env toggle.
tim: can we restart the runtime with env REDWOOD_PAGED_ATTENTION_THRESHOLD=0 to force immediate compaction? if yes, do in a staged fashion.
ara: I can run a rolling restart of the affected pods with env override. but need to avoid mass restarts across cluster. doing only on gpu-node-12 as it drains.
ara: command I'm applying:
```
kubectl -n inference set env ds/rt-pool REDWOOD_FORCE_KV_COMPACT=1 --field-manager=oncall
kubectl rollout restart ds/rt-pool --namespace inference --selector=cloud.node=gpu-node-12
```
leila: also set runtime flag kv_slab_defrag=1 and kv_eviction_aggressiveness=3 if available.
incident-bot: :information_source: Deploy triggered by ara at 17:42 UTC. Rollout in progress.
tim: monitoring resident set and kv_page_free_map. sam, can you tail allocator metrics?
samantha: on it. current kv_free_pages: 12k -> after restart it's 3k (not great). resident increased from 28GB -> 36GB before restart.
ara: post-restart: containers started ok on node; some pods failed to come up and were OOM-killed during init (hence we missed a few). I'm seeing immediate drop in CUDA errors in new containers.
leila: check fragmentation map: page compaction reports high slot scatter — approx 18% unusable due to fragmentation.
samantha: attaching small snippet of metrics:
```
kv_total_pages: 75000
kv_free_pages: 3100
kv_fragmentation_ratio: 0.18
device_resident_bytes: 36_200_000_000
```
tim: still creeping? if fragmentation keeps preventing eviction we'll hit OOM in ~90-120m under normal load. we need a medium-term mitigation: enable background compaction and throttle new paged-attn instantiations on this node pool.
ara: propose: 1) Quarantine gpu-node-12 (cordon kept), 2) Force compaction and set eviction aggressive, 3) Scale up spare nodes and shift new traffic elsewhere, 4) schedule full rolling restart tonight during low traffic to reclaim state.
samantha: agree. scaling up nodes now: autoscaling request to add 2 spare gpus in eu region.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Scaleup request submitted.
leila: quick safety: adjust per-container cgroup memory soft limit to allow host eviction before kernel OOM? Danger: could mask leak. Maybe better to lower container memory limit to allow faster pod eviction and prevent host-level OOM.
tim: i'd prefer not to rely on host kernel; better to ensure runtime can compact. also create a temporary routing rule to avoid placing chat-heavy long-context workloads on paged nodes.
ara: adding routing rule via edge: set model-shard placement to avoid gpu-node-12 pool. patching now.
ara: patch applied — traffic rerouted for heavy context models.
samantha: after compaction trigger: kv_free_pages rose to 18k, device_resident down to 25GB. fragmentation_ratio -> 0.06. good signal.
leila: excellent. capture commands we ran in incident notes for handoff:
- cordon/drain node
- set REDWOOD_FORCE_KV_COMPACT=1
- set kv_eviction_aggressiveness=3
- temporary routing rule to divert long-context workloads
- autoscale + provision spare nodes
- schedule full rolling restart

ara: I'm going to create a follow-up postmortem ticket and tag eng-runtime + infra. we should also run a small fuzz test locally to repro slow bleed (simulate repetitive attention paging with random sequence lengths) and enable allocator diagnostics.
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ACTIONS:
- ara: create postmortem ticket incl logs + timeline (ETA 2h)
- leila: run allocator fuzz test + propose patch to compaction algorithm (ETA 24h)
- tim: validate routing rules and autoscale behavior (ETA 1h)
- samantha: validate customer impact and escalate if tickets appear (ongoing)

samantha: support flagged a couple customers who saw transient 503s. i'm preparing customer-facing blurb: "We observed a small subset of requests briefly failing due to node restarts; we routed traffic and resolved the node; no data loss."
ara: marking incident as mitigated for live traffic at 18:20 UTC. leaving node cordoned until full restart tonight.
leila: note for postmortem: look at paged-attn allocator's interaction with CUDA illegal address. root cause might be use-after-free during high fragmentation compaction attempt.
tim: ok. handing off to eng-runtime for deep triage. oncall shifting back to rota.
ara: handing off. good job team. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: rollout completed on drained node at 18:05 UTC.
